---
name: Feature proposal
about: Propose one focused improvement and its acceptance criteria.
---

## User Problem

Who needs this, and what is blocked today?

## Expected Behavior

Describe a concrete outcome and how we can check it.

## Scope And Boundaries

Which desktop/local/shared modules would change? Note effects on data access,
credentials, external calls, source rights and compatibility with the pinned
baseline. Identify parent work to review separately instead of assuming parity.

Do not include private data or propose an unapproved public release/license as
an already agreed decision.
